name: Project Sentinel Fair Housing
description: Free fair housing education, counseling, and housing discrimination complaint investigation and advocacy
fullDescription: Project Sentinel is a nonprofit housing agency that fights housing discrimination and helps tenants and landlords resolve disputes. In the Bay Area, its fair housing services cover Santa Clara and San Mateo counties and the City of Fremont.
whatTheyOffer:
- Free fair housing education and counseling
- Investigation of housing discrimination complaints
- Help filing complaints and referrals to fair housing attorneys
- Tenant-landlord counseling and dispute resolution (in select cities, including Redwood City and Fremont, and Santa Clara County)
- HUD-certified homeowner counseling (first-time homebuyer education, foreclosure prevention, reverse mortgage counseling)
howToGetIt:
1. Fair housing: call 888-324-7468 or email fairhousing@housing.org (Monday–Friday, 9 AM–4:30 PM)
2. Tenant-landlord counseling: call 800-339-6043
3. Homeowner counseling: call 408-470-3730
4. Describe your housing situation or discrimination concern and staff will explain your rights
5. Services are free
areaLabel: Santa Clara & San Mateo Counties, Fremont
address: 1490 El Camino Real, Santa Clara, CA 95050
keywords: Project Sentinel, fair housing, housing discrimination, equal housing, tenant, landlord mediation, first-time homebuyer, foreclosure prevention, reverse mortgage, disability discrimination, race discrimination, Fremont, Redwood City
